title: Battle Pets
text: There are various helpful and competitive pets to find and level in ArcheAge Classic, Because there is a number of ways to obtain these pets, They are categorized as such below. Pets that are categorized as Starter pets are bought from an intractable box and as such, they do not have a factional affiliation and can be bought and used by any faction. Pets do not share cooldowns and can be rotated under the condition that the pet is not in combat. You can buy as many instances of the same pet as you desire. Once these pets have been obtained they can be placed in any valid farming area, fed a vita root and washed with water, after a short delay turning into full grown pets and being transported to your inventory to spawn as you please. There are various helpful and competitive pets to find and level in ArcheAge Classic, Because there is a number of ways to obtain these pets, They are categorized as such below.

Pets that are categorized as Starter pets are bought from an intractable box and as such, they do not have a factional affiliation and can be bought and used by any faction.

Pets do not share cooldowns and can be rotated under the condition that the pet is not in combat. You can buy as many instances of the same pet as you desire.

Once these pets have been obtained they can be placed in any valid farming area, fed a vita root and washed with water, after a short delay turning into full grown pets and being transported to your inventory to spawn as you please.
